gloss: ability to apply knowledge; practical application skills

definitions.gloss: ability to apply knowledge; practical application skills
definitions.explanation: The capacity to take what one has learned and apply it flexibly to new or different situations. Valued highly in education and the workplace.

examples.japanese: {応用力|おうようりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}につける→身につける：03158_minitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: To develop the ability to apply knowledge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{基礎|きそ}→基礎：03981_kiso⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦しっかりして→しっかりする：21456_shikkarisuru⟧⟦いれば→いる：00495_iru⟧、{応用力|おうようりょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧つく。
examples.english: If you have solid fundamentals, applied skills come naturally.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{暗記|あんき}→暗記：01701_anki⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧{応用力|おうようりょく}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{問|と}われる→問う：02299_tou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: This exam is difficult because it tests not just memorization but also the ability to apply knowledge.

notes:
Describes the practical ability to adapt and apply learned knowledge to new situations. Contrasts with rote memorization (⟦{暗記|あんき}→暗記：01701_anki⟧) and basic knowledge ({基礎力|きそりょく}). A key concept in Japanese education.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {応用力|おうようりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}につける→身につける：03158_minitsukeru⟧: to acquire applied skills
- {応用力|おうようりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have good application ability
- {応用力|おうようりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{試|ため}す→試す：02130_tamesu⟧: to test application ability
- {応用力|おうようりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}う→問う：02299_tou⟧: to test practical application (said of exams)
- {応用力|おうようりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: to have strong application skills

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{応用|おうよう}→応用：04135_ouyou⟧: application — the base noun; refers to applying knowledge or technology in general
- {実践力|じっせんりょく}: practical ability — emphasizes hands-on execution rather than flexible thinking
- {基礎力|きそりょく}: fundamental ability — the complementary concept; solid basic knowledge that supports application

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{応用|おうよう}→応用：04135_ouyou⟧ (application) + {力|りょく} (power, ability).
